title: Empirical Hodge Laplacians: Spectral Convergence and Harmonic Forms from Point Clouds
summary: Let $M^n\subset\mathbb R^d$ be a closed, connected, orientable $C^4$-smooth Riemannian submanifold of dimension $n\ge3$. We construct, for each degree $0\le k\le n$, a family of deformed Hodge Laplacians $Δ_t^k$, $t>0$, defined in terms of the extrinsic geometry of $M^n$, and prove that $Δ_t^k$ converges uniformly to the classical Hodge Laplacian $Δ^k$ as $t\to0^+$. Given an i.i.d. uniformly distributed point cloud $S_m\subset M^n$, we define empirical Hodge operators $\widehatΔ_{t,S_m}^k$.
